slides.texte_overlay:
5 viral theories that will
actually change your life

1. The 1% theory
Get 1% better every day
and nobody notices for months.
Then everyone asks what
changed. Small gains compound.

2. The two-minute theory
Any habit you want, shrink it
to two minutes. One page.
One push-up. Starting is the
hard part. Keep it easy.

3. The five people theory
You slowly become like the
people you spend the most
time with. Look at your five.
Then choose on purpose.

4. The friction theory
Make good habits easy and
bad ones annoying. Book on the
pillow. Phone in another room.
You don't need more willpower.

5. The curiosity theory
Curious people never get stuck.
Every new idea opens a door
you didn't know was there.
Feed your curiosity daily.
